implementation.instructions: Use current host file tools; inspect metadata, preserve originals and use new paths.
Use current host advertised local image viewing, including original-size detail views. Missing vision blocks inspection; do not replace vision with metadata.

Resolve runtime_entry from the current physical Skill installation marker relative to that Skill directory; execute the target-owned CLI and dependencies. Provenance paths are not execution roots. Select generic plus one category template, preserve source regions, inspect actual board and 1600/1920 previews, and enforce the visual/geometry contract. Never infer user approval from technical success. For mode A use board plan/status, panel prepare/attach/review, then board compose; preserve fixed boxes and all other panel originals when revising one panel. Deliver n original images plus the board. Prepare decorated-page photo regions with reference prepare/check, preserve declared evidence at native crop size, and bind source/receipt/review hashes to panel references. Before board plan, run read-only board check-plan and resolve every reported issue; use returned placement requirements as explicit caller decisions after checking live output capability. Draft authorization remains confirmed=false until the user authorizes generation. For A1 use the batch-preparation topic; for A2 use batch-generation, four independent count=1 tasks per group and exact saved templates. Old single-item recovery remains compatible. New mode A work uses board check-plan/plan with layout_id and slot_id, then prepare/attach/review/compose. Native tools consume native-image-execution-1 and return actual originals through attach-native. Record role-strategy changes with revise-intent. Check composition and subject prominence separately from photo rectangle coverage.

Resolve this physical Skill root and its target-owned runtime_entry, then run job create/status/collect and round prepare/attach/review through the product-reference-replacement package CLI. Mode B request preparation remains local; mode A batch-run submit delegates authorized operations to the media CLI. Record an inspected blueprint before preparing new jobs; bind its hash and use product/scene/contact/occlusion/text review checks. Legacy jobs remain recoverable.

For mode B or mode A generation.route=sealseek, dynamically load the canonical sealseek-media Skill and nano-banana-pro contract; preserve task IDs and return one original. Mode A native generation follows native-generation.md and the current host image Skill/tool, with actual output identity bound to the saved request. Respect user provider/model selection; missing capabilities do not authorize switching routes.
Resolve longslice skill source; load current semantic-image-slicer Skill. Complete analyze, actual preview inspection and cut; return ordered slices and coordinates to A1.

Use the target-owned Node.js 22+ application CLI, the current media Skill’s explicitly resolved .mjs launcher and the host-provided environment. Consume exact JSON argv, original task IDs, persistent process results and visual observations. Follow the batch-preparation and batch-generation topics; no host-specific shell wrapper or provider API integration is required.

Resolve and fully load the calling host’s advertised canonical image-generation Skill/tool. Invoke exactly the prepared native-image-execution-1 prompt and ordered references for one output, retain its actual original, and bind a result through panel attach-native. Exposed invocation/model IDs remain real; unknown IDs/model are explicitly absent or null. Verify the host mapping at runtime; generic declaration is not evidence every host was tested.

os_evidence: Script implementation is portable Node.js; macOS verification recorded in development reports. Other OS/Agent runtime evidence remains untested.
